call_questions: What share of first-time investors have invested a second time, and on what timescale?
Which licences or registrations do you rely on, and what happens if retail bond distribution rules tighten?
Which parts of what you do by hand will you automate first, and what breaks when you do?
If an issuer you listed defaults, what happens to your customers and to you?
Your model looks unscalable today - argue why we're wrong, with the specific mechanism.
what_would_change_our_view: Repeat-investment data from the first users, a clear regulatory plan for retail distribution, and a demonstrated mechanism that scales the hand-run trust-building.
